Kentucky Site 3 Barkley Dam

By mrogers August 8, 2025

Barkley Dam

Another Army Corps of Engineers Dam? Yeah, I got carried away. I figured being neighbors of the next dam, and when will I be back over here? So why not take a look? The dam is an earthen gravity dam. It's pretty impressive. Not part of work sites, but I wouldn't mind if it was!
